_help: The defect register: one source for the testing document, the final deck and the target-metric rule (docs/testing/kpis.py). 'scope' is engine, lab or test. A defect with scope 'test' and status 'Open' keeps target K9 (correctness) at 'Partly met'.

defects.found_by: Integration test of two components on one node
defects.defect: Only one of discovery and relay received packets: one receive callback, the last registrant won
defects.fix: A single dispatcher registered last; regression test added

defects.defect: Multi-hop ACK and retry failed: duplicate filtering keyed on the message id dropped every ACK at the first relay and swallowed retries
defects.fix: Key on type, id and attempt; retransmission counter in the formerly reserved header byte; re-ACK duplicates; new tests that fail on the old code

defects.defect: Dead nodes stayed routable: a newer link-state report was merged with the old one, so edges to a dead node never disappeared
defects.fix: A newer report replaces the origin's edges; tests added

defects.defect: A non-ASCII byte in a node-id field made the parser raise UnicodeDecodeError instead of PacketError, so one damaged packet could raise inside the receive path
defects.fix: Decode and encode failures now raise PacketError; both fuzz tests pass

defects.found_by: Repeated runs of the socket tests
defects.defect: Node.stop() hung in about a quarter of runs on Windows: wait_for swallowed a cancellation, so a background loop survived
defects.fix: Helper built on asyncio.wait; 15 of 15 test-file runs and 40 of 40 standalone iterations clean

defects.defect: Two timing-sensitive tests (test_api node-view hop distance; test_ack_multihop) failed in 2 and 1 of 6 runs under load; both pass alone
defects.fix: A wait_until polling helper replaces the fixed sleeps in both tests; the helpers have their own tests

defects.found_by: Repeated full-suite runs of the final suite
defects.defect: test_history_filters_by_priority_and_direction fails intermittently: two messages created in the same millisecond have no defined order, and the test expects newest first. The history query sorts by creation time only
defects.fix: Open: add a second sort key (the row id) to the history query, or compare as sets. The test and the query belong to the device server's owner

defects.found_by: Lab website test, first navigation click
defects.defect: The whole lab website went blank when a menu link was clicked: three React effects returned a value instead of nothing, which React then called as a cleanup function. Opening a page directly by URL did not show it
defects.fix: The effects now return nothing; the browser test (UT-01) clicks through every page and now passes

defects.found_by: Phone-width check of the lab website
defects.defect: The phone header's node selector ran past the right edge of the frame at 390 px width
defects.fix: Selector capped at 46% of the header width; UT-15 passes
